topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: That tow truck had no right to be here. My driveway, my space, and they just took it. The nerve, coming in like they own the place. Now I have to search high and low, pay some ridiculous fee just to get my car back. As if my day wasn’t already a series of hurdles. This is just another unnecessary step, a waste of time, a waste of money. I should be able to park where I please, without some overzealous regulation ruining my plans. It’s not like I was obstructing anything. What a mess.
